about: Agile36 Scrum Master skill library. Skills under skills/ ship in this repo; others download from their authors at the exact commit Agile36 reviewed.

skills.job: Sprint Planning: goal, real capacity, commit vs stretch, dependencies, risks, Definition of Done
skills.try_prompt: Plan Sprint 4: 2 weeks, 6 developers, one on leave Thursday and Friday. Our last three velocities were 21, 18 and 24.

skills.job: Daily Scrum: formats, keeping it to 15 minutes, a quick Sprint Goal check
skills.try_prompt: Our daily standup has turned into a 40-minute status report to our manager. How do I fix it?
skills.author: Agile36

skills.job: Sprint Review: agenda, showing the Increment, getting real stakeholder feedback
skills.try_prompt: Plan a 60-minute Sprint Review. Two of five items are Done and our stakeholders usually skip it.
skills.author: Agile36

skills.job: Sprint Retrospective: pick a format, facilitate it, make actions stick
skills.try_prompt: The same three complaints come up every retro and nothing changes. Plan our next retro.
skills.author: Agile36

skills.job: Backlog Refinement: INVEST checks, vertical splits, Definition of Ready
skills.try_prompt: Refine this story: 'As an admin I want a reporting dashboard so I can see everything.'

skills.job: Scrum of Scrums: coordinate 2-5 teams on one product
skills.try_prompt: We have 3 teams on one mobile app and they keep breaking each other's releases. How do I set up a Scrum of Scrums?

skills.job: Retro data pack from git history: velocity, cycle time, churn hotspots

rewrite.Use to run a\n retrospective, analyze t:
Use to build a data pack for a
  retrospective from commit history, or analyze velocity and throughput
  from git. For facilitating the retro itself, use scrum-retrospective.

skills.try_prompt: (inside a git repo) Build a retro data pack for the last two weeks.

skills.job: Sprint capacity person by person with SAFe normalized points (8 per developer, minus PTO), plus overcommitment risks
skills.try_prompt: Sprint 12, 2 weeks. Team: Ana, Ben, Chloe, Dev, Eli. Ben is out 3 days, Eli 1 day, and Friday is a holiday for everyone. Candidate backlog is 38 points.
skills.author: mmlynxxx-spec

skills.job: Pre-flight check of backlog items before sprint planning: scope, acceptance criteria, size, dependencies, testability
skills.needs: Nothing (makes a Word report and dashboard when the docx skill is on)
skills.try_prompt: Check these stories before planning. 1) 'Improve search performance' (no AC, 8 pts). 2) 'As a user I can export my report to PDF so I can share it' with AC: export button works. 3) 'Integrate with billing API' (13 pts, waiting on Billing team).
skills.author: mmlynxxx-spec

skills.job: Score Jira stories against a 6-point Definition of Ready and draft PO questions and fixes
skills.try_prompt: Check HRT-101 to HRT-105 against our Definition of Ready.
skills.author: mmlynxxx-spec

skills.job: Decide what to keep, cut, defer, split or mark as stretch when the sprint has more work than capacity
skills.needs: Nothing (makes a Word report and dashboard when the docx skill is on)
skills.try_prompt: We have 32 points planned and 24 points of capacity. Sprint goal: launch self-service password reset. Items: reset flow 8, email templates 5, audit log 5, admin report 8, bug fixes 6.
skills.author: mmlynxxx-spec

skills.job: Turn sprint planning outcomes into a shareable summary: goal, committed work, dependencies, risks, capacity and a stakeholder overview
skills.needs: Nothing (makes a Word document and dashboard when the docx skill is on)
skills.try_prompt: Write up Sprint 12 (Mar 3-14). Goal: customers can reset their own password. Committed: reset flow (8), email templates (5), audit log (5). Stretch: admin report. Ben is out 3 days. Depends on the Identity team's API.
skills.author: mmlynxxx-spec

skills.job: Prepare a team for PI Planning: capacity, PI objectives, dependencies, ROAM, confidence vote
skills.author: Agile36

skills.job: Coach Sync, PO Sync and ART Sync: what to bring and how to stop status-meeting drift

skills.try_prompt: Our ART Sync has turned into a 90-minute status meeting. How do I fix it, and what should I bring?

skills.try_prompt: Our team planned 40 business value points and achieved 29. Calculate our predictability and prep the problem-solving workshop.

skills.job: The Scrum Master role: stances, servant leadership, anti-patterns, onboarding, health check

skills.job: Agile coaching: framework choice, maturity assessment, transformation roadmap

skills.job: Diagnose a recurring problem before fixing it: problem statement, verified root causes

skills.job: Scrum Master of record: runs a team's sprints with memory across sessions

skills.job: Team chartering: purpose, working agreements and a first Definition of Done

skills.job: Coach through conflict between team members, with the PO or a manager; scripts the conversation

skills.job: Run a squad health check or psychological safety pulse and turn it into one experiment

skills.job: Run events well for remote and hybrid teams: setup, tools, time zones, engagement

skills.job: Log, triage and escalate a blocker; draft the escalation message

skills.job: Pre-mortem: imagine the launch failed, surface risks, give each an owner

skills.job: Blameless review after an incident, missed launch or failed sprint

skills.job: Split oversized stories into thin vertical slices

skills.job: Talk leadership out of velocity targets and team comparisons; offer better measures
skills.author: Agile36

skills.job: Map stakeholders by power, interest and stance; plan engagement

skills.job: Weekly executive status: highlights, blockers, risks, asks

skills.job: Internal updates, newsletters, FAQs, incident and leadership notes

skills.job: Background reading: roles, artifacts, events, stories, estimation, metrics
